# LayerZeroAdapter
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/adapters/LayerZeroAdapter.sol)

**Inherits:**
OAppRead, [IMessageAdapter](../interfaces/i-message-adapter.md), [IBridgeAdapter](../interfaces/i-bridge-adapter.md), [BaseBridgeAdapter](../base/base-bridge-adapter.md)

**Title:**
LayerZeroAdapter

Adapter for the LayerZero bridge protocol

Implements IMessageAdapter and IBridgeAdapter interfaces and connects to LayerZero's messaging service using
OAppRead standard


## State Variables
### lzMessageToOperationId
Mapping of LayerZero message hashes to operation IDs


```solidity
mapping(bytes32 guid => bytes32 operationId) public lzMessageToOperationId
```


### expectedReadChainByGuid
Binds a read response guid to the originally requested destination chain

Used to enforce registry trust checks for read-channel responses


```solidity
mapping(bytes32 guid => uint16 expectedChainId) internal expectedReadChainByGuid
```


### readChannelThreshold
Threshold used to distinguish LayerZero lzRead responses by `srcEid`

LayerZero routes read responses through a reserved "read channel" range
near the top of the uint32 EID space (commonly with READ_CHANNEL_ID at
4294967295). Any `srcEid` strictly greater than this threshold is treated
as a read response. This value is set at deploy time to allow
forward-compatibility and testing across different environments.


```solidity
uint32 public immutable readChannelThreshold
```


### readChannelId
Active read channel ID for sending read requests


```solidity
uint32 public readChannelId
```


### minGasLimit
Minimum gas limit for operations


```solidity
uint128 public minGasLimit
```


### chainSupportsRead
Mapping of chains that support read operations


```solidity
mapping(uint16 chainId => bool supportsRead) public chainSupportsRead
```


## Functions
### constructor

Initializes the LayerZeroAdapter


```solidity
constructor(
    address _endpoint,
    address _crossChainRegistry,
    address _accessManager,
    uint16[] memory _endpointChains,
    uint32[] memory _endpointIds,
    address _initialOwner,
    uint32 _readChannelThreshold
)
    OAppRead(_endpoint, _initialOwner)
    Ownable(_initialOwner)
    BaseBridgeAdapter(_crossChainRegistry, _accessManager);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_endpoint`|`address`|LayerZero endpoint on THIS chain|
|`_crossChainRegistry`|`address`|Global CrossChainRegistry address|
|`_accessManager`|`address`|Summer protocol access manager|
|`_endpointChains`|`uint16[]`|Chain IDs to map at deploy-time|
|`_endpointIds`|`uint32[]`|Corresponding LayerZero endpoint IDs (Adds only the *mapping*; talking to a peer still requires governance to register it in the registry.)|
|`_initialOwner`|`address`|Owner for Ownable/OAppRead|
|`_readChannelThreshold`|`uint32`|Threshold for determining read-channel responses|


### activateReadChannel

Activates a read channel for state reading operations

Requirements:
- `_readChannelId` must be non-zero
- `_readChannelId` must be strictly greater than `readChannelThreshold`
These checks prevent misconfiguration where read responses would not be
properly classified by `_lzReceive`.


```solidity
function activateReadChannel(uint32 _readChannelId) external onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_readChannelId`|`uint32`|The ID of the read channel to activate|


### configureReadLibraries

Configures ReadLib1002 for read operations

Must be called to enable read operations


```solidity

```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`readLib1002Address`|`address`|Address of the ReadLib1002 contract|


### configureReadDVNs

Configures DVN settings for read operations

Must be called to enable read operations with proper DVN and executor configuration


```solidity
function configureReadDVNs(
    address readLib1002Address,
    address[] memory readDVNs,
    uint64 confirmations,
    address executor
)
    external
    onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`readLib1002Address`|`address`|Address of the ReadLib1002 contract|
|`readDVNs`|`address[]`|Array of DVN addresses for read operations (must be sorted alphabetically)|
|`confirmations`|`uint64`|Number of block confirmations required|
|`executor`|`address`|Address of the executor for read operations|

### mapEndpoint

Map a new chain-id → endpoint-id pair for LayerZero endpoints.

Governance utility. This only updates the local mapping; it does NOT
grant permission to send. That second layer of permission is still
enforced via the CrossChainRegistry.


```solidity
function mapEndpoint(uint16 chainId, uint32 endpointId) external onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`chainId`|`uint16`|    Canonical EVM chain ID.|
|`endpointId`|`uint32`| LayerZero endpoint identifier (EID).|


### unmapEndpoint

Delete the endpoint mapping for a chain.


```solidity
function unmapEndpoint(uint16 chainId) external onlyGovernor;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`chainId`|`uint16`|Chain ID whose mapping should be removed.|

### estimateFee

Estimate fees for a cross-chain operation (unified interface)

This method delegates to estimateTransferFee or estimateMessageFee based on operationType


```solidity
function estimateFee(
    uint16 destinationChainId,
    address,
    uint256,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options,
    BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType
)
    external
    view
    onlyTrustedDestination(destinationChainId)
    returns (uint256 nativeFee, uint256 tokenFee);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`destinationChainId`|`uint16`|ID of the destination chain|
|`<none>`|`address`||
|`<none>`|`uint256`||
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options including adapter selection and parameters|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|Type of operation (0=MESSAGE, 1=READ_STATE, 2=TRANSFER_ASSET)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`nativeFee`|`uint256`|Fee in the chain's native token|
|`tokenFee`|`uint256`|Fee in the transferred token (if applicable)|


### readState

Read state from a contract on a source chain

Initiates a cross-chain state read operation


```solidity
function readState(
    bytes32 operationId,
    BridgeTypes.ExecuteReadStateParams calldata params,
    BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions calldata options
)
    external
    payable
    onlyTrustedDestination(params.destinationChainId)
    onlyRouter
    nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|----|----|-----------|
|`operationId`|`bytes32`|Router-provided operation ID for tracking|
|`params`|`BridgeTypes.ExecuteReadStateParams`|Parameters for the read state operation|
|`options`|`BridgeTypes.BridgeOptions`|Bridge options including adapter selection and parameters|

## Events
### ReadLibrariesConfigured
Emitted when read libraries are configured


```solidity
event ReadLibrariesConfigured(address indexed readLib1002, uint32 indexed readChannelId);
```

### ReadDVNsConfigured
Emitted when read DVNs are configured


```solidity
event ReadDVNsConfigured(uint32 indexed readChannelId, address[] readDVNs, uint64 confirmations);
```

### ReadExecutorConfigured
Emitted when read executor is configured


```solidity
event ReadExecutorConfigured(uint32 indexed readChannelId, address indexed executor, uint32 maxMessageSize);
```
